load_pretrained_model: use torch hub to load a pretrained fairseq model by name via the auto-exposed model functions
use_bpe_tokenizer: use the bpe hub interface to apply byte pair encoding tokenization to input text
use_tokenizer: use the tokenizer hub interface to tokenize input text with a fairseq tokenizer
check_dependencies: check that all required fairseq dependencies like torch and hydra are installed before importing
build_cython_extensions: automatically build fairseq cython extensions in place when torch hub imports the module
